name: Hurt
overview: Scripture reveals the reality of hurt and pain through Christ's own cry of abandonment on the cross, showing that even He experienced profound suffering (Mark 15:34). Believers are called to respond to those who hurt them with love and kindness, reflecting Christ's grace rather than retaliation (Luke 6:27). Recognizing that all have sinned and fallen short of God's glory (Romans 3:23) encourages forgiveness and compassion, while the epistle of James reminds believers of their identity as servants of God amidst trials and hurt (James 1:1). This teaches the importance of letting go of hurt and extending forgiveness, following the example set by Jesus.
